sources.title: Green Bionanocomposites Based on Polyhydroxybutyrate and Filled with Cellulose Nanocrystals: Melting Processing and Characterization
sources.read: Full HTML methods/results; table links returned main text, no separate numeric tables used
sources.use: Melt processing, low CNC loading, uptake below 1 wt% after 1056 h immersion, DMA versus wet creep distinction
sources.limits: PHB P338, not PHBH. Immersion temperature not established from accessible method text. Thick specimens and dry dynamic tests do not validate wet microscale joints.

sources.title: Effects of Cellulose Nanocrystals and Cellulose Nanofibers on the Structure and Properties of Polyhydroxybutyrate Nanocomposites
sources.use: Solution-cast PHB comparison; arithmetic audit of textual 31.2 to 27.1 MPa versus claimed 3.5% decrease
sources.limits: Do not infer corrected experimental data from arithmetic. Preparation uses sulfuric acid/chloroform; no field recipe adopted. No wet 50C joint test.

sources.title: セルロースナノファイバー補強によるバイオマスプラスチック用途拡大の推進：1G-2101終了研究成果報告書
sources.kind: Primary project final report, FY2021–2023, Kyoto University and collaborators
sources.read: PDF extracted text, printed pp10–11,14,17 and relevant methods; raster tables not read
sources.use: PHBH/CNF recycling and thermal trends; internal biodegradation and porous processing are distinct evidence
sources.limits: Summary outcomes not joint constants. No numeric HDT table import; 5 recycling cycles do not validate 240 maintenance operations/year. Do not extrapolate marine film lifetime to slope.
